snippet.title: Update on Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea
snippet.description:
We wanted to let our community know that Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea will now be releasing on October 15th. Thank you for your patience and support. Your excitement and encouragement mean the world to us.

Today, we are sharing a glimpse into the mysterious dreams you will experience in Teradea. As we count down to October 15th, we're excited to share more updates and first looks. Stay tuned for more!
